findings.summary: The engine resolved its rubric with Path(__file__).parents[2], a path that exists only in a source checkout. A normal pip install produced a working import and console script that then failed at runtime with FileNotFoundError.
findings.fix: Moved rubric/mamakscore-v3.yaml into src/mamakscore/data/, declared [tool.setuptools.package-data], repointed the 8 test files. Verified by reinstalling into a clean venv.

findings.summary: In workbook.py the candidates comprehension paired cells with _number(cell.value), typed Decimal or None, and never narrowed it. The subsequent greater-than comparison and division by Decimal(100) could execute against None.
findings.fix: Rebuilt as an explicit narrowing loop so only non-None Decimals enter candidates.

findings.summary: _period() returned a bare str into FinancialInput.period, which requires Literal monthly/annual/point_in_time/unknown. A typo would have produced a validation error at runtime instead of a type error at check time.
findings.fix: Introduced PeriodLiteral and annotated _period() with it.

findings.summary: verify_red_flag_evidence() skips any red flag whose evidence_quote is empty, and RedFlag.evidence_quote defaults to an empty string. Category scores are held to a stricter rule (an empty quote is permitted only when score is 0 and the justification is exactly the not-stated text). A model could therefore emit an unevidenced red flag that passes grounding.
findings.recommendation: Either require a non-empty evidence_quote on RedFlag, or apply a category-style rule (empty quote permitted only for flag_type missing_information). Deferred because it changes a data contract and warrants client confirmation.

findings.summary: The project lives on the Desktop, which is iCloud-synced (the CloudDocs Desktop entry is a symlink to ~/Desktop). Python stalled at 0% CPU on ordinary file reads: a run needing 1.08s of compute took 3m45s of wall clock.
findings.fix: Renamed .venv to .venv.nosync with a symlink, which excludes it from iCloud and cut interpreter startup from 90s to 2.1s. Verification runs were executed from a local scratchpad copy of identical bytes.
findings.recommendation: For sustained development, keep the working copy outside iCloud-synced Desktop, or exclude the project directory from sync.

honest_summary: The engine is built, typed, tested, packaged, and verified end-to-end in a clean environment. Every score it has produced so far comes from a deterministic offline fixture and is not a judgement of any startup. Connecting a real model and running a human-agreement study are the two things standing between this and a defensible assessment tool.
